ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Shree Tirupati Balajee Agro Trading Company Limited has submitted a routine compliance filing with stock exchanges, providing its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent's (RTA) certificate for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as per SEBI Regulation 74(5). The RTA confirmed adherence to all prescribed procedures for dematerialization, including timely processing, mutilation, and cancellation of share certificates. A key takeaway, however, is that despite the procedural confirmation, the detailed report explicitly shows *no* physical share certificates were actually dematerialized during the entire quarter, indicating an absence of activity in this specific area.
